2115427672981451034.en_summary: (Reposted by @RyanDetrick) @chriskatje notes that Oct. 28 is historically the best trading day of the year for the S&P 500, crediting @RyanDetrick, and links a Benzinga piece on why 2026 could be different, joking not to blame the birthday boy if $SPY is down today.
2115427672981451034.zh_summary: （由 @RyanDetrick 轉發）@chriskatje 指出 10 月 28 日歷來是標普 500 全年表現最好的交易日，並歸功於 @RyanDetrick，附上 Benzinga 文章連結，說明 2026 年為何可能不同，並調侃若 $SPY 今天下跌不要怪壽星。

2115429814777909275.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay, quoting @KraneShares, says $ANT went from operating margins of -249% in Q1 2025 to +8% in Q2 2026, roughly $1B in quarterly operating profit, while spending about $10B on R&D in six months, because revenue grew about 29x versus only about 6x growth in compute spending. An image is attached.
2115429814777909275.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 引用 @KraneShares 指出，$ANT 的營業利潤率由 2025 年第一季的負 249% 升至 2026 年第二季的正 8%，相當於單季約 10 億美元營業利潤；同時六個月內研發開支約 100 億美元，原因是營收增長約 29 倍，而算力開支只增長約 6 倍。附上圖片。
